title: Development and validation of a prototype for the on-line simultaneous analysis of quality caprolactam
author: Fernández, Rincón, et al.

steps.title: Initialize caprolactam flow
steps.instruction: Open valves V-101 and V-102 simultaneously for 0.01 min each to allow caprolactam to pass through the pipe that leads to valves V-201 and V-301; then close both valves.

steps.title: Add water – first portion
steps.instruction: Open valve V-103 for 1 min to introduce water and create a caprolactam‑H₂O solution; then close V-103.

steps.title: Add water – second portion
steps.instruction: Open valve V-104 for 35.2 min to pass additional water through the system; then close V-104.

steps.title: Introduce HCl
steps.instruction: Open valve V-105 for 2.3 min to add hydrochloric acid (HCl) to the flowing stream; then close V-105.

steps.title: Introduce pyrosulfate
steps.instruction: Open valve V-106 for 3.1 min to add pyrosulfate to the mixture; then close V-106.

steps.title: Introduce H₂SO₄
steps.instruction: Open valve V-107 for 30.5 min to add sulfuric acid (H₂SO₄) and obtain the final acidic solution; then close V-107.

steps.title: Pass caprolactam through V‑201
steps.instruction: Open valve V-201 for 10.5 min to allow caprolactam to flow further; then close V-201.

steps.title: Measure mixture extinction
steps.instruction: Open valve V-202 for 5.2 min to direct the caprolactam‑water‑acid mixture through the spectrophotometer and record its extinction; then close V-202.

steps.title: Pass caprolactam through V‑301
steps.instruction: Open valve V-301 for 10.5 min to continue caprolactam flow; then close V-301.

steps.title: Heat mixture and remove SO₃
steps.instruction: Open valve V-302 for 8.2 min so the mixture passes through a heater where SO₃ vapors are removed; then close V-302.

steps.title: Store hot fluid
steps.instruction: Open valve V-303 for 8.5 min to store the heated fluid; then close V-303.

steps.title: Cool mixture (first stage)
steps.instruction: Open valve V-304 for 10.2 min to cool the stored mixture; then close V-304.

steps.title: Transfer cooled fluid
steps.instruction: Open valve V-305 for 30.2 min to allow the cooled fluid to move to the next stage; then close V-305.

steps.title: Re‑heat mixture
steps.instruction: Open valve V-306 for 32.5 min to heat the mixture again; then close V-306.

steps.title: Store reheated solution
steps.instruction: Open valve V-307 for 32.5 min to store the reheated solution; then close V-307.

steps.title: Cool mixture (second stage)
steps.instruction: Open valve V-308 for 35 min to pass the solution through a cooling unit; then close V-308.

steps.title: Continue cooling
steps.instruction: Open valve V-309 for 35 min to further cool the solution; then close V-309.

steps.title: Final heating step
steps.instruction: Open valve V-310 for 40.5 min to heat the solution once more; then close V-310.

steps.title: Store final heated solution
steps.instruction: Open valve V-311 for 60.5 min to store the final heated solution; then close V-311.

steps.title: Final cooling and spectrophotometry
steps.instruction: Open valve V-312 for 80 min to cool the solution before it passes through the spectrophotometer for the final measurement; then close V-312.

description: Considering the proposed model where a prototype was designed that executes the different tests simultaneously, we proceeded to characterize a sample of caprolactam from the same batch under the same operations to evaluate the content of iron, ash, material insoluble in water and the extinction present [17].
